name: Nimbadi Kashayam

sections.reference_chakradatta_jwara_chikitsa_101: Nimbadi Kashayam , also known as Nimadi Kashaya , is a well-known classical Ayurvedic liquid formulation. Its primary ingredient is Neem (Nimba) , renowned for its powerful detoxifying and anti-inflammatory properties. This kashayam is a concentrated herbal decoction prepared through a traditional method, where selected natural herbs are boiled in water to extract their therapeutic essence. The result is a potent, water-based herbal preparation that supports skin health, digestion, and overall detoxification in a natural way.
sections.ingredients:
Neem – Azadirachta indica 
 Ginger- Zingiber officinale 
 Giloy – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Daru – Cedurs deodara 
 Shati – Hedychium spicatum 
 Bhunimba – Andrographis paniculata 
 Paushkara – Inula racemosa 
 Pippali – Long pepper- Piper longum 
 Gajapippali – Scindapsus officinalis 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 

 Method of Preparation 
 Boil the above ingredients using water till it is reduced to 1/4th then filter it.
sections.dose:
Take 12 – 24 ml of kashaya before food, or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually advised to add an equal amount of water to the kashayam. 
 It is advised to take a little honey after taking this kashayam.

sections.side_effects:
There are no known side effects. 
 Note – Special care and precaution is required while administering this medicine to people with diabetes. 
 Its Overdose may lead to stomach irritation and gastritis. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Nimbadi Kashayam 
 Reference: Chakradatta Jwara Chikitsa 101, Sahasrayogam. 
 Nimbadi Kashayam , also known as Nimadi Kashaya , is a well-known classical Ayurvedic liquid formulation. Its primary ingredient is Neem (Nimba) , renowned for its powerful detoxifying and anti-inflammatory properties. This kashayam is a concentrated herbal decoction prepared through a traditional method, where selected natural herbs are boiled in water to extract their therapeutic essence. The result is a potent, water-based herbal preparation that supports skin health, digestion, and overall detoxification in a natural way. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Neem – Azadirachta indica 
 Ginger- Zingiber officinale 
 Giloy – Tinospora cordifolia 
 Daru – Cedurs deodara 
 Shati – Hedychium spicatum 
 Bhunimba – Andrographis paniculata 
 Paushkara – Inula racemosa 
 Pippali – Long pepper- Piper longum 
 Gajapippali – Scindapsus officinalis 
 Brihati – Solanum indicum 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Boil the above ingredients using water till it is reduced to 1/4th then filter it. 
 Dose 
 Take 12 – 24 ml of kashaya before food, or as directed by an Ayurvedic doctor. 
 It is usually advised to add an equal amount of water to the kashayam. 
 It is advised to take a little honey after taking this kashayam. 
 Indications 
 
 Boils 
 Malignant wounds 
 Diabetic carbuncles 
 Pimples 
 Abscess 
 Gangrene 
 Cysts 
 Furunculosis 
 
 Side Effects 
 There are no known side effects. 
 Note – Special care and precaution is required while administering this medicine to people with diabetes. 
 Its Overdose may lead to stomach irritation and gastritis. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
